== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４：マサッシ式典の間</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-138o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">位置カードを出すとき、このカードを一番最初にだせばライトサイドが先攻。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを占領していれば、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room.

'''Light Side:''' When playing locations, if this is the very first location played, the Light Side goes first.

'''Dark Side:''' If you occupy here, add 1 to the Force drain.
